title: Feelings
info: Characters have feelings. Readers use clues to name them.
If someone slams a door and frowns, they might be angry. If they jump and smile, they might be happy.
Feelings can change from the start of a story to the end.

questions.q: A smile and a jump often show
options: That the character is a setting

questions.q: A frown and crossed arms can show
